summary: Reproduces on main (13730886e) and on all 20 stable releases v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607; access violation reading 0x8, matching the reported message byte-for-byte from v1.6.2104 on (the two oldest releases crash with empty stderr, so a text predicate would falsely score them clean). ApplyTypeSpecSignToParsedType returns m_scalarTypes[newScalarType] (SemaHLSL.cpp:11233), which is null unless the source already named that type, since only six scalar slots are pre-populated and the rest are created lazily by LookupScalarTypeDef; naming uint16_t earlier makes the identical declaration compile. Wider than the title: also crashes as a local, parameter and struct member, and for any user typedef (typedef int MyInt; unsigned MyInt g;) with no 16-bit type or flags involved. Vector/matrix shorthands escape because they prime the scalar typedef, which is why the only in-tree test covers unsigned int64_t2 and not unsigned int64_t. Clang-HLSL already rejects the construct.
title: unsigned int{16,32,64}_t at global scope causes Segfault (attempted to read from 0x8)
